analysis: Examined the single modified test file provider-swift/Tests/ProviderCoreTests/ProviderLoop/ProviderLoopStreamChunkTests.swift. Changes are test-only: lines 59, 282-283, 299 and 312 adapt tests to a type change in the upstream MLXLMServer API, where tool-call deltas are now OpenAIToolCallDelta (wrapped via OpenAIToolCallDelta(call)) with an optional `function`. The tests still assert deterministic, framed encoding for tool calls in the response-hash domain (encodeToolCallsForHash, \u{1F} markers), tool_calls delta surfacing, usage extraction, logprobs and reasoning-token injection, and capPending bounding. No production code, crypto, authorization, attestation, cache storage or network surface is changed in this unit, so no regression against the retained threat model (T-008, T-041, TB-002, TB-007) is evident. Remaining integration question outside this unit: the production ProviderLoop.parseStreamChunk and encodeToolCallsForHash signatures must accept OpenAIToolCallDelta. Given the optional `function` in the delta type, the hash encoding of partial or nil function deltas should stay deterministic and must not fail open to plaintext. That production code was not supplied here, so no conclusion about it is drawn.
